verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Plaid serves an llms.txt at plaid.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a Plaid summary header, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The doc sources are also served as per-page markdown (e.g. /docs/auth/index.html.md), which is agent-friendly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering, evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage, and a markdown docs root (/docs/.md returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://plaid.com/llms.txt # Plaid
